name: Voidspark
description: A survivable seed of Void-purity, filtered through space and time. Required to endure and shape true Void workings.

synergies: Unlocks Void techniques that would otherwise be lethal.
Pairs with Spell Study and Essence Weaving (space/time patterns).
Acts as a safety filter: reduces the narrative risk of raw Void exposure.

name: Meditation
description: Restore mana and health while meditating.

name: Herbalism
description: Identify and harvest medicinal herbs.

synergies: Pairs with Alchemy (herbs are core potion ingredients).
Works with Cooking/survival; herb knowledge lets you enhance meals and avoid poisonous plants.
Combined with druidic magic, you can grow rare herbs faster and amplify their potency for powerful remedies or poisons.

name: Blacksmithing
description: Craft and repair weapons and armor.

synergies: Pairs with Enchanting: forge high-quality gear, then enchant it for greater effect.
Works with Mining (to gather ores) and Engineering (complex items).
Well-crafted items can serve as ritual components and withstand magical strain better than crude work.
